purpose: Local lightweight open-weight model profiles for the separate PSQ-SCO scenario generation engine.

prompt_only.purpose: Prompt-engineered baseline without RAG or ontology grounding.

prompt_rag.purpose: Existing prompt template plus retrieved examples from the project RAG corpus.

ontology_text_rag.purpose: Existing prompt+RAG plus PSQ-SCO OWL records transformed into graph-to-text RAG documents.
ontology_text_rag.recommended_for: Main three-mode comparison: prompt_only vs prompt_rag vs ontology_text_rag.

ontology_prompt_rag.purpose: Legacy ontology semantic-packet mode kept for backward-compatible experiments.
ontology_prompt_rag.recommended_for: Earlier two-mode comparison: prompt_rag vs ontology_prompt_rag.

transformation_methods: static Graph-CoT-inspired control trace (not iterative Graph-CoT)
deterministic greedy relevance walk (legacy output label: deterministic_random_walk_graph_to_text)

graph_cot_basis.paper: Graph Chain-of-Thought: Augmenting Large Language Models by Reasoning on Graphs
graph_cot_basis.adaptation: The engine creates a static, deterministic, auditable control trace. It does not implement the paper's iterative LLM reasoning, graph interaction, and graph execution loop.

terminology_limits.preferred_name: ontology-to-text retrieval with deterministic record ranking and an optional greedy relation walk

qwen2_5_7b.role: structured JSON and multilingual scenario generation

mistral_7b.role: concise scenario wording and fast local generation
